candidates.transcript_evidence: So are there any common gestures that you know of which have a unique or different meaning in different cultures?
candidates.description: 询问已知的在不同文化中具有独特或不同含义的常见手势

candidates.transcript_evidence: So I'm not sure if you know, but what does this mean in Chinese when you say this?
candidates.description: 询问某个手势在中文中的含义

candidates.transcript_evidence: So when you're counting with your fingers, this could mean eight in Chinese.
candidates.description: 说明在中文中手指计数可表示数字八

candidates.transcript_evidence: But in some European countries, like in Germany, some people would say this is two.
candidates.description: 指出在某些欧洲国家如德国，同一手势表示数字二

candidates.transcript_evidence: And that's something I've experienced when people say, I want this much beer.
candidates.description: 提及个人经历中有人用手势表示想要这么多啤酒

candidates.transcript_evidence: I was like, eight beers, okay. And they're like, no, two.
candidates.description: 描述因手势歧义导致误以为要八杯啤酒，对方纠正为两杯

candidates.transcript_evidence: And have you ever used a pen?
Have you ever experienced or witnessed a situation where a gesture would lead to misunderstanding because of cultural differences?
candidates.description: 询问是否经历或目睹过因文化差异导致手势误解的情况

candidates.transcript_evidence: And how do you think this would affect interactions between people from different cultures?
candidates.description: 询问文化交流中手势误解可能带来的影响

candidates.transcript_evidence: Also, it could be a bit offensive.
candidates.description: 指出手势可能具有冒犯性

candidates.transcript_evidence: How do you think the Chinese language is different from the Chinese language?
candidates.description: 询问中文与中文之间的差异（原文重复，保留）
